PRIMARY INDUSTRIES

Designed around how your buyers make decisions.

Technology and software businesses need relevant commercial conversations. Education providers need informed student enquiries and consistent counselling follow-up. The growth system must reflect those differences.

PRIMARY FOCUS

Our primary focus is established technology/software and education businesses in Nepal. We shape the work around the audience, the offer and the team that owns the next step.

ENGAGEMENT FIT

Growth needs something worth growing.

A working product or programme, existing customers, capacity to serve more demand and a team available to follow up are useful starting conditions.

For technology clients, demos and closing remain client responsibilities. For education providers, programme accuracy, counselling and admissions remain with the institution.
